title: Purge
body:
Syntax: purge

Description: (Staff only.) Deletes every mob, ground item, and corpse in the room you're currently standing in, all at once -- a quick way to clean up a test area or clear out clutter. Always targets your current room; no argument needed.

Mobs removed this way still respawn normally later if they're a respawning template -- purge clears the room right now, it doesn't permanently depopulate it.

Date: 2026-08-17
